\vspace{-0.7in}

Here are a few more practice problems for our next quiz this Friday.

## Problems 

1. Let $f(x) = 101^x$.

   a. Write down the difference quotient for $f$.
   b. Use a little algebra to separate out the $x$s and $h$s in your difference quotient.

2. Use the differentiation rules to compute the derivatives of the following functions:

   a. $\displaystyle f(x) = 101^x$
   \vspace{0.1in}
   b. $\displaystyle f(x)=e^{2x+3}$
   \vspace{0.1in}
   c. $\displaystyle f(x)=\ln(4x^2+1)$
   \vspace{0.1in}
   d. $\displaystyle f(x)=x^3e^{-x}$
   \vspace{0.1in}
   e. $\displaystyle f(x)=(2x^2-5x+1)2^x$
   \vspace{0.1in}
   f. $\displaystyle f(x)=\frac{e^x}{x^2+1}$
